name: Coriander

basicInfo.description: Coriander, also known as cilantro, is a fast-growing herb used for both its fresh leaves and dried seeds. It grows quickly in cool seasons but can bolt in hot weather.
whyGrow: Adds unique flavor to many dishes
Leaves and seeds are both edible
basicInfo.sunlight: 4-6 hours of sun, prefers cooler temperatures

growingSteps: Sow seeds directly into soil, 1 cm deep
Water regularly to keep soil moist
Harvest leaves early to prevent bolting
Allow some plants to flower for coriander seeds

careCalendar.description: Plant seeds directly in soil or pots.
Pick young leaves before plants bolt.
If desired, let plants flower and collect coriander seeds.

harvestingGuide: Harvest coriander leaves when they reach 10-15cm. Cut outer leaves first or harvest whole plants. For seeds, allow the plant to flower and dry before collecting.
estimatedSavings: Growing coriander at home can save $30–50 per year compared to buying bunches from supermarkets.
